//: The Build Command configured in the Vercel dashboard is stale — it reads `prisma generate && next build`, which predates scripts/sync-videos.mjs and silently drops it. That script is the only thing that creates public/videos/portfolio/, and that directory is gitignored on purpose (it is generated output; committing it would store every clip twice). So the videography clips never existed in the deployment and every <video> src returned the 404 page. A buildCommand here overrides the dashboard, and delegating to `npm run build` keeps package.json the single source of truth for the build.
